nodes.name: button_shape: pill
nodes.description: Fully rounded ends; friendly, consumer, soft products.

nodes.name: button_shape: rounded
nodes.description: Radius from the scale (6 to 10px); the neutral default for product UI.

nodes.name: button_shape: square
nodes.description: No radius; editorial, Swiss, brutalist and luxury directions.

nodes.name: button_fill: solid
nodes.description: Primary fill with on-primary text; one per view.

nodes.name: button_fill: outline
nodes.description: 1px border in text colour, transparent fill; quiet and editorial.

nodes.name: button_fill: ghost
nodes.description: No border, tinted on hover; toolbars and secondary actions.

nodes.name: button_fill: soft
nodes.description: Low-chroma tint of primary with primary text; dark and soft directions.

nodes.name: input_edge: hairline
nodes.description: 1px border, 2px focus ring; the accessible default.

nodes.name: input_edge: filled
nodes.description: Surface fill, no border until focus; soft and dark directions.

nodes.name: input_edge: underline
nodes.description: Bottom rule only; editorial and luxury forms with few fields.

nodes.name: card_edge: border
nodes.description: 1px border, no shadow; borders earn their place.

nodes.name: card_edge: shadow
nodes.description: Soft layered shadow under 6% total opacity; one radius from the scale.

nodes.name: card_edge: flat
nodes.description: No border, no shadow; grouping by spacing and background only.

nodes.name: card_edge: inset
nodes.description: Translucent surface over colour with a 1px inner highlight; glass and luminous directions.

nodes.name: nav: airy
nodes.description: Wordmark left, few links right, 72px tall, no border until scrolled.

nodes.name: nav: compact
nodes.description: 56px tall, hairline bottom border, dense links; technical sites.

nodes.name: nav: floating
nodes.description: Detached pill or panel with blur, 16px from the top edge.

nodes.name: nav: sidebar
nodes.description: Vertical navigation for app shells and documentation.

nodes.name: divider: hairline
nodes.description: 1px rule in border colour between sections.

nodes.name: divider: space
nodes.description: Whitespace only; section rhythm from the spacing scale.

nodes.name: divider: rule
nodes.description: 2px to 4px rule in text colour; Swiss and brutalist directions.

nodes.name: image_corner: none
nodes.description: Square imagery.

nodes.name: image_corner: sm
nodes.description: Small radius matching cards.

nodes.name: image_corner: lg
nodes.description: Large radius; soft and playful directions.

nodes.name: focus_ring: offset
nodes.description: 2px ring in focus colour, 2px offset; default and most visible.

nodes.name: focus_ring: inset
nodes.description: 2px ring inside the element; square directions.

nodes.name: focus_ring: glow
nodes.description: 0 0 0 4px ring at 40% alpha; dark and soft directions.

nodes.name: link_style: underline
nodes.description: Always underlined in text colour; editorial and accessible default.

nodes.name: link_style: colour
nodes.description: Primary colour, underline on hover.

nodes.name: link_style: both
nodes.description: Primary colour and underline.

nodes.name: elevation: none
nodes.description: Nothing floats; layering by colour and border.

nodes.name: elevation: one
nodes.description: A single soft shadow level for raised surfaces.

nodes.name: elevation: layered
nodes.description: Two or three shadow levels plus blur for glass surfaces.

nodes.name: Press scale
nodes.communicates: The control is physical and responded

nodes.name: Button loading swap
nodes.communicates: Working; label replaced by spinner, width held

nodes.name: Toast slide in
nodes.communicates: A message arrived at the edge

nodes.name: Page shared-element slide
nodes.communicates: This element travelled to the next page

nodes.name: Scroll reveal, once
nodes.communicates: One orchestrated entrance for the hero

nodes.name: Ambient glow drift
nodes.communicates: Alive but quiet; dark directions only

nodes.name: Paper editorial
nodes.summary: Warm off-white canvas that reads like paper, a serif display face over a quiet sans, hairline rules, one restrained accent.

nodes.name: Swiss grid
nodes.summary: Black, white and one accent on a visible grid; type does the work, nothing is decorated.

nodes.name: Monochrome engineering
nodes.summary: Greys with colour only where it means something, one sans for everything and mono for code, borders that are earned.
tells_to_avoid: mono for anything that is not data

nodes.name: Soft product
nodes.summary: Friendly product UI: large radius, soft layered shadows, a clear primary, airy cards, pill buttons.
tells_to_avoid: the same grey shadow under everything

nodes.name: Dark console
nodes.summary: Near-black neutral surfaces, hairline borders, mono labels for data, one restrained accent; the look of a good terminal.
tells_to_avoid: medium grey body text on black

nodes.name: Luminous dark
nodes.summary: Dark canvas with one glowing hue, blurred gradient light, glassy raised panels and product imagery doing the talking.

nodes.name: Quiet luxury
nodes.summary: Generous space, a refined serif, muted low-chroma palette, square corners and almost no chrome.

nodes.name: Neo-brutalist
nodes.summary: Flat saturated fills, thick dark borders, hard offset shadows, raw grotesque type; deliberately unpolished.

nodes.name: Playful geometric
nodes.summary: Bright flat colour blocks, geometric shapes, pill everything, bouncy motion; made to be liked.

nodes.name: Warm organic
nodes.summary: Earth tones, rounded forms, generous line height, photography with large radius; calm and human.
tells_to_avoid: cream and terracotta as a default

nodes.name: Glass layered
nodes.summary: Translucent panels over a coloured field, blur used only where a surface really floats over content.

nodes.name: Bento showcase
nodes.summary: A grid of unequal cells, each showing one real product capability with a small mono caption.
tells_to_avoid: cells with icons instead of product

nodes.name: Poster type
nodes.summary: Display type at poster scale is the image; everything else is small, aligned and quiet.
tells_to_avoid: one word in a different colour
italic serif as the only idea

nodes.name: Data dense
nodes.summary: Tables first: tabular numerals, tight rows, sidebar navigation, colour reserved for status.
